title: uxc resource catalog (registry.json)
description: Every resource the package owns or references: kind, id, file path, sync policy (DESIGN §8). Written by uxc add/adopt/rm; committed and exported. Unknown keys are tolerated.

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it.

resources.description: One entry per resource. uxc keeps them sorted by kind/id.

kind.description: Resource kind (uxc help kinds). An unknown kind stops status/push.

id.description: Server id (handlers: the LOGICAL name without _vN; goals: goalName+promptId[+filterHash]; tag-class deltas: the target tag class).

path.description: Package-relative path of the file or directory (posix separators).

policy.description: managed = full write; createOnly = create if absent, never delete (fd.taskclass updates in place); external = referenced only, never written or deleted. Default: the kind's.

retired.description: Tombstone: deliberately removed from the server; skipped by push unless --revive.
